raw.overview: The advisors show strong consensus regarding the financial implications of the relocation package relative to your stated constraint. All three assessments calculate the total gross relocation value at $18,000, derived from the $10,000 stipend and $8,000 reimbursement. Based on applying your specified 35% marginal tax rate to this full amount, the resulting net after-tax cash is consistently calculated as $11,700.
raw.points_of_note: The critical point of convergence across all reports is that the calculated net cash of $11,700 falls short of your mandatory minimum threshold of $14,000. The advisors uniformly flag this discrepancy. Furthermore, they all highlight the underlying assumption that the entire $18,000 is subject to tax withholding without any gross-up mechanism, which is the central area requiring verification.
raw.suggested_next_step: Given the unanimous finding that the current structure results in a net cash flow below your required $14,000, the immediate next step must be to seek clarification from the employer regarding the tax treatment of the $18,000 package. Specifically, confirm if any non-taxable components exist or if a gross-up structure can be implemented to meet the $14,000 net minimum.
